name: Musumejoku
source:
I was a lecturer far away from Japan when I received the news that my wife's condition had deteriorated. I returned to Japan without any possessions, but I could not take care of her, it was too late.

One day, Satoru, who now teaches at the school where his two daughters attend, is summoned by the director and asked about his daughter Isuzu's marriage proposal.

"Don't be ridiculous! It's too early for Isuzu to get married!"

"Come to think of it, the other day I saw Runo walking with a male student in a friendly manner, no way, is he her boyfriend?"

"Damn, it was my wife's last gift to me that my two daughters and I could live together!"

"I won't let a stranger destroy it! Isuzu and Runo are mine!"

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ008922.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
当我收到妻子病情恶化的消息时，我正在远离日本的地方担任讲师。我回到日本时身无分文，但我无法照顾她，已经太晚了。

有一天，在两个女儿就读的学校任教的悟被校长叫去，询问女儿五十铃的求婚事宜。

“别开玩笑了！五十铃结婚还太早了！”

“想起来了，那天我看到鲁诺和一个男学生友好地散步，不会吧，他是她的男朋友吗？”

“妈的，我和两个女儿可以住在一起，这是我妻子送给我的最后一份礼物！”

“我不会让陌生人毁掉它！五十铃和鲁诺是我的！”
